title: Timeline shift-select: multi-frame selection
description: Implemented shift-click frame range selection in Timeline.tsx. Plain click sets an anchor and selects a single frame; shift+click extends the range from the anchor to the clicked frame. Selected frames are highlighted in Flash 8 blue (rgba(50,100,220,0.55)). The selection range is stored as { layerId, start, end } local state, with an anchorFrameRef tracking the last non-shift click. Copy/cut context-menu actions now use the selection range when the right-clicked frame shares the same layer. All 174 unit tests pass; TypeScript builds clean.
